story: The early breakaway included five riders, with Tom Maingenaud securing the mountains jersey. Baptiste Veistroffer attacked from the breakaway at 40km but was caught 12km from the finish. Olav Kooij won the sprint, earning his first victory of the year after a long injury layoff.
